from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the case and their role."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the person or organization")
    role: str = Field(description="Legal role such as plaintiff, defendant, or appellant")

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Official case number and jurisdiction."""
    number: str = Field(description="Official case number string (e.g., (2022) 粤 0105)")
    location_hint: str = Field(description="City or district location mentioned in the number")

class Court(BaseModel):
    """The court that issued the judgment."""
    name: str = Field(description="Full name of the court")
    location: str = Field(description="City or district location")

class RulingOutcome(BaseModel):
    """A specific order or decision made in the judgment."""
    action: str = Field(description="Summary of the action (e.g., assist transfer, dismiss appeal)")
    target: str = Field(description="Who or what the action applies to")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim snippet from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted evidence from a single legal document."""
    parties: list[Party]
    case_identifiers: list[CaseIdentifier]
    courts: list[Court]
    rulings: list[RulingOutcome]
    document_type: list[str]
